title: 银行卡丢了：挂失和补办
summary: 借记卡丢了：马上打电话挂失，确认有没有可疑扣款，申请补新卡。

phrases.en: I need to freeze my card.
Can you send me a new card?

phrases.zh: 有没有未经授权的扣款？

phrases.en: How long will the new card take?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi, I lost my debit card. I need to freeze it right away.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我的借记卡丢了，要马上冻结。

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Can I have your name and account number?
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉，请问你的姓名和账号？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Li Wei. Are there any unauthorized charges?
dialogue.zh: Li Wei。有没有未经授权的扣款？

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Your card is now frozen. I don't see any suspicious charges.
dialogue.zh: 卡已经冻结了，没看到可疑扣款。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Good. Can you send me a new card?
dialogue.zh: 那就好，能给我寄张新卡吗？

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Of course. It will arrive in 5 to 7 business days.
dialogue.zh: 当然，5 到 7 个工作日寄到。

seoTitle: 美国银行卡丢了英语怎么说？挂失对话
seoDescription: 在美国借记卡丢了：打电话挂失、查可疑扣款、补新卡的完整英语说法，附真实对话。
